No result or level is ever in a text","slab_obstacles":"Heat tubing, cables or a sewer line under the slab: the crew stops and moves the spot; the start may move","weak_suction":"Weak suction at the far side of the slab: a second suction point by change order","backdrafting":"Gas appliances: venting and carbon monoxide are checked after the fan goes in, where the rules require it; a carbon monoxide alarm is a stop","post_test_high":"The post-install test is still high: the crew adjusts the system at no charge (the example's warranty), and a retest is booked","permit_late":"The start moves with no fee; Alex is told","inspection_fails":"The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the final bill waits","cancel_after_window":"Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own","nobody_home":"Tests with the lockbox set, with start and end photos","over_license_limit":"Not offered, and the owner is told why","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last bill waits","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
